AncestryHold.message: Fixed enum only; invalid reasons reject with a fixed message or normalize to a safe enum.

ReadBudget.new_method: hop() reduces the shared parent-hop balance; exhaustion raises AncestryHold('BOUND_EXCEEDED').
ReadBudget.bounds: Strict positive integer limits, rejecting bool and limits above hard maxima. Byte/snapshot exhaustion is also fixed BOUND_EXCEEDED.

_find_predecessor_commit.receipt: Existing bound VerifiedSnapshot from authenticated reader; verify its binding.
_find_predecessor_commit.metadata: Read raw cat-file -p immutable commit headers, including at shallow boundaries. Bound commit object at 64 KiB and remaining bytes before payload read (cat-file -s preferred). Require one valid tree header and exactly one valid parent header before the blank-line separator. Valid signed continuation lines and message parent words are not parents. Reject malformed/merge/root/self/cyclic parents.
_find_predecessor_commit.selection: Charge the shared parent hop before fetch. Fetch only the immediate parent through existing filtered repository. Validate only latest.json as 100644/blob/exact path. Read its selected bounded manifest through the same actual-byte budget. The only skip is full header plus cipher equality to the starting receipt's manifest. First distinct manifest must have generation exactly newer-1 and cipher exactly newer.header.previous_cipher_sha256. Any distinct mismatch is INPUT_OR_CHAIN_INVALID; never search past it.
_find_predecessor_commit.local_and_global_bounds: max_hops is a strict integer1..128 local cap, additionally bounded by shared ReadBudget.hop. Exhaustion is BOUND_EXCEEDED, not proof absence.
_find_predecessor_commit.no_authority: No mutable head/ref lookup, graph walks via rev-list/log, full historical tree scan, REST, source HTTP, writes, proof minting, or decryption.

_extend_authenticated_chain.signature: _extend_authenticated_chain(repository, bootstrap, current, older_chain, *, feed, guard, budget) -> tuple[VerifiedSnapshot,...]
_extend_authenticated_chain.control: Run the existing real matcher before searching and after every appended authenticated receipt. Search only on HOLD/ACTIVE_PROOF_MISSING. Return the current older tuple on ALL_ORPHAN_ANCHORS_PROVEN, NO_ORPHAN_ANCHORS, or any other matcher HOLD. Never mutate current/initial older chain or return a partial proof decision.
_extend_authenticated_chain.reader: Call _find_predecessor_commit on the last older receipt, then existing _read_verified_snapshot for that candidate with day=current._view.event_date_jst. Preserve the same feed/guard/bootstrap/repository/shared budget. Existing F/H owns AEAD.
_extend_authenticated_chain.bound_failures: Propagate only the fixed AncestryHold; a failed/uncertain extension yields no successful partial chain to the public caller.

run_audit.addition: Catch AncestryHold from load_pair before generic exceptions and emit fixed HOLD with that approved reason, counts=null, snapshots=[] and all six effect flags unchanged. Continue mapping ordinary unexpected reader exceptions to AUTHENTICATED_PAIR_UNAVAILABLE. Capture noisy output and never leak raw errors or private values.
